title: Medical College of Wisconsin Inaugurates Dr. Shekar N. Kurpad as President and Chief Executive Officer
summary_en: Shekar N. Kurpad, MD, PhD, was inaugurated as the Medical College of Wisconsin’s seventh President and Chief Executive Officer in a ceremony held on September 17, 2026, in Milwaukee, Wisconsin.
